# DabDesign Hue Ramps — Catalog

**Status: Approved (DEC-014, effective 1.0.0).** Generated by
`scripts/hue-catalog.mjs`; values are ratified and checked.

Adopted from Tailwind CSS v3.4.17 (`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/v3.4.17/src/public/colors.js`, MIT, frozen 2026-11-15).
Eleven steps, 50–950. White and black are separate primitives, not ramp
steps. Tailwind hand-tunes each hue at a different lightness, which is what
makes the warm ramps vivid; gray is already Tailwind Neutral.

## White and black

Separate primitives, not ramp steps:

| Token | Hex |
|---|---|
| `white` | `#FFFFFF` |
| `black` | `#000000` |
